column1: # Ash Jenna, an antagonist, confronts the party in Tolbi after Colosso.

column3: There you are, Isaac. I was\nstarting to think you'd\nnever come.{end_wait}
Jenna? What happened to\nyou? You're grey... Come\nback with us.{end_wait}
Come back? The fire took\neverything soft in me.{page_break}What's left is ash, and ash\nremembers.{end_wait}
Jenna, this isn't you! Snap\nout of it!{end_wait}
Poor Garet, always the loud\none.{page_break}Be quiet and burn quietly.{end_wait}
An ash girl with a grudge.\nHow tedious. Know your\nplace.{end_wait}
Mia, the blade's daughter.\nWe're the same, you and I.{page_break}The light made us both.{end_wait}

Light the next one, Isaac.
Every flame you kindle
feeds me.{page_break}I'll be waiting at the top,
and all of you will be
dust.{end_wait}
